summary: Public Storage filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 providing Regulation FD disclosure and other events. The filing is a routine current report with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. It contains no material definitive agreement, material modification to security holder rights, change in control, or departure of directors or principal officers. Accordingly, this is not a special situation and should be categorized as None.
